events.title: Charlotte Mayerson's Overlook Concerts
events.description: Riverside Park Conservancy and our generous supporters present the Fall 2026 edition of Charlotte Mayerson’s Overlook Concert series, featuring talent from Brownstone Brass, The Manhattan School of Music’s Center for Career Readiness & Community Impact, and French Cookin’ Blues Band. October 4: Brownstone Brass Quintet - Classic brass quintet repertoire, original arrangements and compositions, new music and more.October 11: A Jazz Ensemble from the Manhattan School of Music – A glorious sound floats over the park as these student musicians play traditional and contemporary music.October 18: French Cookin’ Blues – This Blues Hall of Fame band plays authentic Blues from around the country for a special New York sound.

venue.address: 116th Street Overlook (in Riverside Park), New York, NY, USA

events.title: Midtown Music in Greeley Square Park
events.description: Featuring a multitude of musical moods ranging from pop-up performances for passers-by to festival shows curated by cultural partners, Midtown Music has something for every ear. Hear NYC’s finest singer-songwriters workshop their newest material, catch up-and-coming Indie or Americana acts, relax to some jazz or party with a brass band. Check out our website for additional Friday and Saturday shows!
